title: Phase 56F: Polish state banner hierarchy

files_changed.note: Replaced 2-letter code icons (FT/AS/SS/...) with simple Unicode glyphs (◆/●/✓/◐/↻/!/◇/◌). Added .banner-56f modifier class. All 11 contexts + 5 tones preserved.

Appended Phase 56F section: 10 new selectors (.banner-56f, .banner-56f.banner-{info,success,warn,fail,neutral}, .banner-56f .banner-icon, .banner-56f .banner-body, .banner-56f .banner-title, .banner-56f .banner-desc). 0 :root changes; count remains 5.
New test file with 12 test classes.
New design + scope + visual-review checklist doc.

preserved: All 11 banner contexts still supported (factory_template, user_created_project, etc.)
All 5 banner tones still supported (info, success, warn, fail, neutral)
role='status' and aria-label accessibility attributes preserved

hard_gates.previous_phases_preserved: 56B Help + 56C v1 form + 56D COD derivation + 56E project switch all intact

coverage_areas: All 11 banner contexts still have _title and _desc
All 5 banner tones referenced in template and defined in CSS
.banner-56f class applied; smaller padding (0.5rem vs 0.75rem); smaller icon (22px vs 28px); no heavy shadow
Each context uses a single Unicode glyph (old 2-letter codes FT/AS/SS/BD/UC/SR/LR/VF/DO/PR are gone)
Original .banner rule preserved for backward compat
All 5 tone styles defined for both old (.banner-{tone}) and new (.banner-56f.banner-{tone}) variants
12 forbidden terms absent (no positive no-go claims)
No debug-style language (stack trace, exception, panic, abort, fatal)
Scope guardrails: app.js, main_web.py, waterfall_core, project_factories, runtime_impact_taxonomy, persistence all unchanged
Template still uses banner_context and banner_tone|default('info')

recommended_review_order: Visual: open app, observe state banner when applicable; confirm calmer/more compact than before
Visual: confirm icon is a single Unicode glyph (◆/●/✓/◐/↻/!/◇/◌) not 2-letter code
Visual: confirm accessibility attributes (role=status, aria-label) still present
Visual: confirm all 5 tones still distinguishable (info/success/warn/fail/neutral)
